success.description: A huge white wolf appears in the engagement of your choice within medium range. The wolf counts as an ally and is under your control. On your turn, the wolf can make 1 manoeuvre for free, and can make additional manoeuvres by discarding tokens from this card. If the wolf is attacked, do not roll dice - simply discard a token from this card. Your allies engaged with the wolf gain +1 defence. Attacks against enemies engaged with the wolf gain {Dc}

sigmarsComet.description: Attacks enemies engaged with the wolf gain +1 critical

conservative.requirements: 8 favour, Strength 4+, you and your allies must be outnumbered in battle
